scope: Marketplace control plane, official plugin catalog, and Customer School universal host

gaps.finding: Railway independently builds the API and worker from the same source snapshot, producing different immutable image digests even though both services run the same backend Dockerfile and source snapshot.
gaps.requiredExit: Build the backend image once in CI, publish it to a registry by digest, and configure both Railway API and worker services to deploy that exact digest. Keep the existing same-image preflight fail-closed.

gaps.finding: The isolated worker inherited MARKETPLACE_URL without the API role's pinned update-repository and entitlement public keys, so it crash-looped and could not process activation jobs until the trust anchors were copied manually.
gaps.requiredExit: Make Marketplace connection and signing-key rotation an atomic multi-role configuration operation, include the worker and its persistent volume in Railway IaC, and add a hosted preflight that rejects API/worker trust-anchor drift before rollout.

changesInThisAudit: Removed the obsolete Academic plugin source test from Customer School.
Made legacy migration compatibility tests self-contained and checksum-registry based.
Added a reproducible plugin-host contract command and made it the CI gate.
Added migration and cross-plugin contract runtime coverage to the required host CI gate.
Upgraded Announcements 0.2.0 to universal SDK 1.3 UI with portable creation, listing, scheduling, and settings workflows.
Added a Marketplace-owned Announcements behavior contract and a released-host schema contract.
Upgraded all fourteen official plugins to SDK 1.3 universal declarative UI and added a catalog-wide fail-closed CI gate.
Converted the final schema-v1 Parent Portal pages to universal child, link-request, and administrator request workflows.
Moved 107 official-plugin behavior tests across thirteen suites from Customer School into their owning Marketplace plugin packages and added a dedicated Marketplace CI gate.
Moved Document Designer behavior and cross-plugin row-scope coverage into Marketplace; the official plugin gate now runs 167 behavior tests.
Removed every implicit Customer School filesystem reference to an official plugin source tree; catalog lifecycle, schema, and browser acceptance now require PLUGIN_SOURCE_CATALOG explicitly.
Replaced the Announcements-dependent package compatibility test with a source-independent plugin scaffold fixture.
Verified 21 universal host browser flows across phone, tablet, and desktop against the externally mounted Marketplace catalog.
Added a fail-closed Customer School CI boundary gate that rejects implicit relative or absolute official-plugin source dependencies.
Verified the isolated Railway customer-school certification environment is healthy, core-only, Marketplace-connected, and running identical API/worker image digests without targeting production.
Removed implicit sibling-repository fallback from PostgreSQL certification source resolution; operators must explicitly mount WATTANAM_PLUGIN_SOURCE_ROOT.
Fixed the Organizing Management migration certification to derive its expected immutable migration sequence from the signed manifest instead of a stale hard-coded count.
Separated seven source-independent recovery contracts from the thirty-one explicit external-catalog PostgreSQL harness contracts in Customer School CI.
Verified thirty-nine observability, health, rollout, contract-runtime, entitlement-audit, and metrics-authentication contracts.
Verified isolated Railway readiness returns HTTP 200 and unauthenticated metrics access fails closed with HTTP 401.
Audited all production dependency trees in both repositories at high severity; no vulnerabilities were reported.

Fixed fresh Marketplace database startup so the complete additive RBAC catalog is seeded after migrations and before narrow permission repairs; the isolated API now starts healthy without weakening authorization.
Corrected isolated Marketplace public-origin configuration and verified Customer School rejects a production-origin approval URL before accepting the isolated-origin link flow.

Published and installed signed Organizing Management 0.23.0, activated 64 immutable migrations, updated active to 0.23.1, manually rolled back, and retained 0.23.0 after an induced execution-time migration failure.
Created and restored a fresh hosted recovery set into a separate disposable PostgreSQL database and staging directories; plugin installation version and all 64 migration records match the source.
